visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Copy with a method instead of by hand
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Each field of the object is copied one by one, including the inner one. Use JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(...)) for the copy. The result shown must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The by-hand copy must be edited whenever a field is added, and it is easy to forget one. A JSON round trip copies whatever the object holds, as long as it is plain data.

checks.label: The original keeps x and the copy has y
